properties.name: A5225/26 / EVRR
properties.originalText:
UKRAINE CRISIS:
ALL AIRCRAFT, INCLUDING UNMANNED AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC)
ISSUED BY THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO
ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY LATVIAN AIRSPACE EXCEPT HUMANITARIAN, SAR,
LEASED AIRCRAFT ONE-WAY RETURN FLIGHTS, AIRCRAFT WITH MAXIMUM
SEATING CAPACITY OF 4 PERSONS AND TAKE OFF MASS UP TO 2000KG FOR
PRIVATE, NON-CORPORATE, RECREATIONAL AND TRAINING FOR PRIVATE PILOT 
LICENSE
AND RELATED RATING WITH UNION TRAINING ORGANIZATIONS WITH THE 
PERMISSION OF THE APPROPRIATE LATVIAN AUTHORITIES AND IN CASE OF 
EMERGENCY LANDING OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT. 
OTHER AIRCRAFT OPERATORS OPERATING FLIGHTS BETWEEN THE RUSSIAN 
FEDERATION AND LATVIA, WHETHER DIRECTLY OR VIA A THIRD COUNTRY, SHALL
 NOTIFY THE MINISTRY OF TRANSPORT (E-MAIL: AVIATION(AT)SAM.GOV.LV) 
AND THE CIVIL AVIATION AGENCY (E-MAIL: CAA(AT)CAA.GOV.LV) AT LEAST 96
 HOURS PRIOR TO THE FLIGHT AND SUBMIT ALL RELEVANT INFORMATION 
CONCERNING THE FLIGHT, INCLUDING THE DOCUMENTS REFERRED TO IN ARTICLE
 3D(1A) OF REGULATION (EU) NO 833/2014.
properties.source: FAA NMS — PRODUCTION / 本番環境
